title: Your free business page
summary: Every business gets a free page at usetikka.com/your-name. Put it in your Instagram and WhatsApp bio.

steps.title: Open Your page
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Your page. On a computer, it's in the menu on the left.

steps.title: Add a hero photo and headline
steps.body: Under Hero, add a wide, bright photo of your space or your best work, a headline and a short line under it. Tap the part of the photo that matters most so phones never cut it off.

steps.title: Say how customers use their Tikka
steps.body: Choose whether people come to you, you go to them, or you work online anywhere in Nigeria. This decides whether your page shows your hours, address and Directions.

steps.title: Add what people ask about
steps.body:
Add your story (About), services and prices, your team, FAQs, a text section and your best work (Portfolio). Each service gets a "Book on WhatsApp" button; group them (like Hair or Nails) to show them in tabs.

Sections you leave empty don't show on your page. Add what you have and come back for the rest.

steps.title: How booking works
steps.body: When someone taps Book on your page, they pick a day and time, and WhatsApp opens with their request written. You confirm with them on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Share the address
steps.body: Copy your page address and put it in your Instagram bio, your WhatsApp Business profile and anywhere else people find you. When you're running a drop, your page shows it, and reviews from people who redeemed show there too.

tips: Your business page is always free, even when you're not running a drop.
